note: The rich wave, step 2 of docs/art/RICH_STYLE_EXPERIMENT.md 'The wave this opens': today's items redrawn from themselves at 64 px per tile (4x today's 16 px), in the shared ramps, style rich. Items are up to 64 art px, so they go down the free route (DECISIONS 2026-10-22, drawing route by size): pnpm kit:gen tools/kit-gen/rich-items.json --drawer kaggle. Best of three, judged by eye (a name spells its hyphens as _, as kit:gen requires; the kit id keeps its own spelling); the picks go into the kit with their ramps. Each what + detail stays short and names shapes, materials and light, never pixel counts, so the same line reads for an image model with a 77-token prompt and for Codex. Gold has no shared ramp: the coin draws in fire, and a gold ramp is the owner's call if it reads wrong.
